connect.title: Connect with the agents
connect.body: Use one of your AI agents to connect the taskbag with your project folder. It opens in the project folder with a request already typed in; nothing is sent until you send it there. The request asks the agent to add Allomos's instructions to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (and to create a file that is missing), so every new session knows how to work with the taskbag.
connect.asked: Opened {agents}. Read the request there and send it. If {first} finds existing tasks, its plan appears here, and you choose Go ahead or Cancel.
notice.restart_agents: New in the project folder: {files}. AI agents read these files only when a session starts, so sessions that were already open in this project don't know about Allomos yet. Start a new session to use it.
welcome.hint: Select a folder where you want to keep your tasks.
wizard.title: Set up the taskbag
wizard.what_body: A taskbag holds your project's tasks: what is planned, who is working on what, how far each task has got, and the notes one person or AI agent leaves for the next. It is a folder of plain text files named {dir}, so you can keep it in Git with your project. You see it here in Allomos; AI agents use it through the alm command.
wizard.choose_hint: Choose the folder where the taskbag should go. Usually this is your project's own folder: {dir} is then created inside it.
wizard.found_title: This folder already has a taskbag
wizard.found_body: Allomos will use the taskbag in {path}. To use another one, choose a different folder.
wizard.missing_title: No taskbag in this folder yet
wizard.missing_body: Allomos will create {dir} in {folder}, with an empty taskbag inside. Nothing else in the folder changes.
wizard.git: This folder is inside the Git repository {repo}. Allomos commits the taskbag there (only the taskbag's files; nothing is pushed).
wizard.source_title: Connect the folder that holds your project
wizard.source_body: The project folder holds the project's code and documents, and the instruction files AI agents read when a session starts (AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md). Agents work in this folder. It is usually the folder you chose in step 1; choose another one if the taskbag is kept apart from the project.
wizard.created_body: The new, empty taskbag is in {path}.
connect.tasks: The agent you choose will also look for tasks the project already keeps, such as a task board, card files or a to-do list. If it finds some, it shows you its plan here and moves them into the taskbag only if you choose Go ahead.
welcome.eyebrow: Shift between AI agents and teammates
welcome.lede: When one AI agent or account runs out, another picks up where it stopped. When you hand the work to a teammate, nothing stays behind in a chat. The project travels in its taskbag: plain files in your own repository.
fig.title: A task shifts from Claude Code (account 1) to Codex (account 2) when the quota is used up, then to a teammate at hand-off; all three read and write the same taskbag in the repository.
wizard.no_git: This folder is not under Git yet. Allomos makes it a Git repository and commits the taskbag there, so the taskbag's history is kept. Nothing is pushed.
wizard.git_init: {folder} was not under Git, so Allomos made it a Git repository (git init) and committed the taskbag to it. Git keeps every version of the taskbag's files, so you can see what changed and when, and undo a change. Nothing was sent anywhere: the repository is only on this computer.
wizard.git_committed: Committed the taskbag to the Git repository {repo}.
problem.git_init_failed: The taskbag is saved, but {path} could not be put under Git: {detail}
wizard.git_init_title: Your taskbag is now kept in Git
wizard.git_help: New to Git? Ask your AI agent: “What is Git? What is it used for?”
wizard.git_missing: Allomos keeps the taskbag in Git, but Git is not installed on this computer, so the taskbag is saved without its history for now. Install Git, then ask your AI agent to make {folder} a Git repository and commit the taskbag.
wizard.git_missing_help: Not sure how? Ask your AI agent: “What is Git? What is it used for? How do I install Git?”
problem.git_missing: Git is not installed on this computer, so the taskbag is saved but not kept in Git yet.
